name: Longbow
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Longbow: martial ranged weapon; 1d8 piercing; properties ammunition, heavy, two_handed; mastery slow. Range and Versatile values are in definition. The complete property and mastery rules on pp.89–90 apply only when their requirements are met.

authored_operations: Use declared weapon proficiency, ability, hands, range and properties for each actual attack; Finesse uses the same chosen ability for attack and damage. Thrown draws as part of the attack and retains the melee ability.

Light extra attack requires a different Light weapon and omits a positive ability modifier; Nick moves that single extra attack into the Attack action. Apply only an unlocked mastery with its exact target, timing and once-per-turn rules from source context.

Ammunition attacks require and spend one Arrow; recover floor(half spent) after one minute following the fight. Heavy melee needs Strength 13 and Heavy ranged needs Dexterity 13 to avoid Disadvantage; enforce normal/long ranges and Two-Handed only when attacking.

definition.name: Longbow
definition.description: A tall bow with impressive range.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Map complete weapon properties, masteries, hand/ability eligibility and actual attacks through shared owners. Reuse verified range/Heavy work; no item-ID dispatch or support claim from seed fields.
Separate Arrow pieces from purchase lots and Quiver; refuse empty attacks, spend/recover exact counts once, preserve counters at checkpoints.
